description: Optional account-anchored invalidation fired by a seller that can detect when a package–creative assignment is added, removed, or its aggregate/scoped approval outcome changes. Registered through sync_accounts notification_configs with event_types: ["creative.assignment_changed"]. Receivers verify signing, dedupe, and reread get_media_buys; a creative-library seller may also expose a bounded list_creatives reverse projection, but the webhook does not replace the authoritative relationship snapshot.

ext.description: Extension object for platform-specific, vendor-namespaced parameters. Extensions are always optional and must be namespaced under a vendor/platform key (e.g., ext.gam, ext.roku). Used for custom capabilities, partner-specific configuration, and features being proposed for standardization.
ext.title: Extension Object

notification_id.description: Stable identity for this logical assignment change across re-emissions.
